subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

__I would agreed that these programs__ can be good for learning things that nobody else will teach you.

options.text: I will have agreed that these programs
I will have to agreed that these program

solution:
The correct answer is: **I agree that these programs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**I would agree**" with "**I agree**" to correct the sentence.
 
• ‘**I agree**” is = Subject + Verb and is in the present tense.
 
• “**I would agreed**” is = Subject + Verb + Verb [which is incorrect] more over, "would" and "agreed" both are past tenses, so two past tenses cannot be put together.
 
• In English, if you want to show that you share the same opinion in a simple way, you could say:** "I agree"**
 
• If we read the next part of the sentence, then we will know that the sentence is written in the Simple future tense.
 
• Therefore, the rest of the options except option 1 are incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence:** *I agree that these programs can be good for learning things that nobody else will teach you.*
